description: Link a wiki page to an issue. The link then shows on both the issue and the page, and survives the page being renamed or moved. Identify the page by 'pageId', or by 'spaceKey' + 'title'. Linking the same page again updates that link instead of adding a second one. Requires permission to edit the issue.

relationship.description: How the page relates to the issue, free text — e.g. 'documentation' (the default), 'specification', 'design'.

spaceKey.description: Space key, when identifying the page by title.

title.description: Exact page title, when identifying the page by title.

name: link_wiki_page
